description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
What's new in 0.28.0
Undo for deletes
- Deleting a note or folder from the sidebar now shows an undo toast; press mod+Z or click Undo to restore it immediately.
- New "Show toasts" setting to control confirmation toasts.
Shortcuts
- Editor-bound shortcuts moved to a single registry with explicit route scopes, so custom bindings apply consistently inside the editor (rich and raw markdown modes) and never fire on the wrong screen.
- Editor search shortcuts and focus handling improved; the shortcut cheat sheet reflects the new scopes.
Coverage for the shortcut system grew with dedicated route-scope and editor-binding test suites (804 renderer tests green).
